name: Root Film
source:
Spirited young filmmaker Rintarou Yagumo is involved in a new TV project—a mystery drama production set in Shimane that also served as tourism promotion for the prefecture. It has been 10 years since the original pilot was shot, and while the project was discontinued for unknown reasons, plans for a revival seems to be in place. One of the characteristics of this project is that it is a competition between three filmmakers, and each filmmaker shoots using a different actress as the protagonist. Yagumo is excited to learn that the other two filmmakers are famous directors. Before long, Yagumo and the staff members head off to go pre-location scouting, but a murder occurs at their destination…

 Yagumo and Riho are the two protagonists. As you progress through each of their stories and unravel records of the past, you will witness the truth… Root Film is a mystery title developed with realistic and beautiful backgrounds from data that was carefully gathered of Shimane Prefecture, which is where the story is set. Enjoy the deep story written by [url=https://vndb.org/s8782]Hifumi Kouno[/url], which points to the catharsis of art and madness in the darkness of today’s internet society.

[from [url=https://gematsu.com/2019/10/root-film-announced-for-ps4-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
充满活力的年轻电影制作人八云伦太郎参与了一个新的电视项目——一部以岛根县为背景的悬疑剧制作，同时也作为该县的旅游推广活动。距离最初的试播集被拍摄已经过去了10年，虽然该项目因未知原因而中止，但复兴的计划似乎已经到位。这个项目的特点之一是，它是三位电影制片人之间的竞争，每个电影制片人都以不同的女演员作为主角进行拍摄。八云很高兴得知另外两位电影制片人都是著名导演。不久，八云和工作人员出发去预先地点侦察，但目的地却发生了一起谋杀案……

 八云和里穗是两位主角。当你逐步了解他们的每个故事并解开过去的记录时，你将见证真相……《Root Film》是一款悬疑游戏，以故事发生地岛根县精心收集的数据为基础，以现实而美丽的背景为背景。欣赏[url=https://vndb.org/s8782]Hifumi Kouno[/url]所写的深刻故事，它指出了当今网络社会黑暗中艺术与疯狂的宣泄。

[来自[url=https://gematsu.com/2019/10/root-film-announced-for-ps4-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
